prices.name: Repaint a bumper

sources.title: Cost of a Car Bumper - Car Repair and Maintenance - CostHelper
sources.quote: Installing and painting the new bumper can cost $200-$600 or more, bringing average total costs to $300-$1,600 or more.

sources.title: How Much Does it Cost to Paint a Car? | CARFAX
sources.quote: Midlevel: Some trim and the bumpers are removed, there’s more surface preparation, and higher-quality paint is used. The cost is $3,500 to $5,000, and the warranty is three to five years.

prices.name: Repaint the whole car (standard)

sources.title: Is Paint Covered Under Warranty?
sources.quote: This process costs between $1,000 and $3,000 on average.

sources.title: How Much Does it Cost to Paint a Car? | CARFAX
sources.quote: The estimated cost is $1,200 to $2,200, and the warranty is for six months to a year (set by the paint manufacturer).

prices.name: Repair a windshield chip or small crack

sources.title: How Much Replacing a Car Windshield Costs 2026 - CostHelper
sources.quote: Repairing a crack in a front car windshield can cost $30-$150, depending on local conditions, the length of the crack and how many there are. Users report paying $30-90 for windshield repairs, typically paying about $50.

sources.title: How Much Does It Cost To Replace My Car's Windshield? | Endurance Warranty
sources.quote: You can often repair small chips for around $40

prices.name: Replace a windshield
prices.includes: Common windshield; rare or dealer-only glass costs more

sources.title: How Much Replacing a Car Windshield Costs 2026 - CostHelper
sources.quote: Replacing a front car windshield typically costs $180-$400, depending on the model and type of vehicle, as well as whether the replacement windshield is OEM or aftermarket. Users report paying $160-$600 for a windshield replacement, at an average cost of $282.
